question: If PAYMENT is coded as 7174552, then how would YOUNGER be coded?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d26a4107141c8988092be3a6f971de10fd85269bdcee88518465cc72c114f65.png] 

Given: PAYMENT is coded as 7174552,

The logic followed here is:

The sum of the digits of the positional values of the given letters, as shown below,

 
• **Double digit → Addition**
 
• **Unit digit → Same**
